messages:
anya: Quick thread: proposing bidirectional eviction handshake between admission and batcher to reduce noisy drops.

tom: Why bidirectional? Admission currently sends "evict" and assumes tokens free immediately. That mismatch causes retries when batcher is compacting.

rashid: Sketch: admission -> controller: EvictProposal{tenant, want_tokens, deadline_ms}. Controller fans to batcher streams. Batcher -> controller: CapacityOffer{offered_tokens, eta_ms, kv_load}.

claire: Agree on streams not per-request RPCs. Add disposition enum: OPEN | SOFT_BLOCK | HARD_BLOCK and an emergency_overcommit flag.

anya: Observability notes: handshake_latency_p90, offered_efficiency = sum(offered_tokens)/sum(want_tokens), and fence_transition_count by tenant. Alert if efficiency < 0.2 for 3m.

tom: Failure modes: controller disconnect -> admission uses last-known snapshot for TTL (30s) then route to cold-path. Security: internal mTLS + auth.

rashid: Implementation plan: 1) proto + streams; 2) controller router; 3) dashboard + alerts; 4) small chaos test.

ci-bot: CI: proto changes require adding proto-gen step and unit for stream decode.

anya: Action items: @tom prototype stream, @rashid dashboard, @claire security checklist. No objections, will write short RFC follow-up. :thumbsup:
